title: Existential risk from artificial intelligence
displaytitle: Existential risk from artificial intelligence

titles.display: Existential risk from artificial intelligence

extract: It has been hypothesized that substantial progress toward artificial superintelligence (ASI) will lead to human extinction or another irreversible global catastrophe. Debates center on whether AI can achieve the capabilities needed for human extinction, the speed of self-improvement, and the effectiveness of strategies to keep it aligned with human values.
